learning_outcomes.text: To know the fundamentals of electronics, analog and digital.
To know the main devices for designing analog electronic circuits.
To know the elementary components for designing a Digital Electronic System.
To know the principles governing the operation of Memories and Microprocessors.
Is capable of designing, simulating, and building electronic circuits in the laboratory, obtaining results, and drawing conclusions from them.
Is capable of working in a team, applying critical reasoning, making decisions, and communicating knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Semiconductors: Intrinsic and extrinsic semiconductors, diodes, bipolar transistors.
Bipolar transistor. Biasing and analysis at medium frequencies.
teaching_methods: Presentation of concepts and problem-solving sessions in the classroom.
Personal study, report writing, practical work.
assessment_rules: Students must achieve a grade equal to or greater than 5 in each of the two blocks to pass the course. For the ordinary exam, students can choose to take only the 3rd partial or the entire exam. For the extraordinary July exam, students will be evaluated on the material associated with the three partials (75%), retaining the scores from completed practicals and assignments (25% of the final grade).
